messages:
morgan: FYI found a path where PII (example: SSN/email) can get attached to embeddings in the debug/canary store.
lee: Yikes. Is this reproducible?
sara: Can you give a sanitized example of the flow?
morgan: Repro: client sends prompt with SSN, header X-Debug-Inspect=true, capture config persisted orig + embedding -> saved blob. Console shows original when inspect enabled.
vikram: Our full-text scrub only touches logs, not the embedding index. The index is used for rerank/search.
lee: So impact is mostly debug captures and a few canary tenants?
morgan: Correct. But still problematic.
sara: Options: a) pre-embed redaction, b) encrypt original with tenant KMS + gated UX, c) store only hashed/synthetic provenance.
vikram: Pre-embed redaction changes vector semantics; KMS adds friction; hashing loses replayability. Need compromise.
lee: What about defaulting persist_original=false, run redaction before embedding, and offer an audited decrypt path?
morgan: That mirrors what I was thinking. Also console should surface redaction confidence and a button "Request original (audit)".
devex: paste the capture config to propose a new shape.
morgan: Snippet: {"capture": {"inspect_enabled": true, "persist_original": true, "persist_embedding": true}, "headers": {"X-Debug-Inspect": "true"}}
lee: Suggest add redaction_level: "none|partial|full" and make persist_original opt-in per-tenant.
vikram: Implementation notes: lightweight regex scrub as fallback (fast), ML-based PII model behind feature flag. Pre-embed hook ~5-20ms on debug path. We'll also add a sampling rule (0.1%) for original persistence during canary.
sara: Storage/egress cost is also a good reason to default off.
morgan: Proposed action items: - Default persist_original=false - Pre-embed redaction for any persist_embedding - Console: redaction confidence + audited request button - Backfill plan for existing blobs
lee: I'll own SRE canary + quota limits.
vikram: I'll add pre-embed hook PR with regex scrub and flag ML model.
sara: I'll mock console UX and ticket flow.
devex: Ping compliance/legal once the RFC exists.
oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall runbook to document the audited unwrap flow.
morgan: I'll draft the RFC and link designs. Keeping thread for updates.
